question: By whose grace does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
By that lord's grace the speaker has come to know.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: Knowledge of the Kaula determination is granted by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not stated explicitly.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
